comment: Independent C-first untrap recipe. Inputs fixed before C observation or JS comparison. Initial C-only setup: observe the adjacent newt position before creating a pit under the hero and luring it through that square. C-only command correction: the current upstream extended command is #wizgenesis, not the older #genesis spelling. C-only position observation: the newt is south of the hero at creation. Make a pit at the current hero square, move north to lure it over the pit, then attempt to rescue it southward. C-only setup correction: the first north square was a wall and the wished pit was unseen. Start one square south in the room, map the pit, then move north to lure the newt into it. In the corrected C-only setup the newt spawns north of the hero; move south and rescue northward rather than attacking it. The C newt falls into the pit only after one subsequent wait; wait before rescue and allow three ordinary source chance attempts.
